主要内容: BROOKFIELD ASSET MANAGEMENT INC. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on January 24, 2019. The filing includes a preliminary term sheet dated January 24, 2019, and a press release dated January 24, 2019. The documents are incorporated by reference into the Registration Statement of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. and Brookfield Finance Inc. on Form F-10 (File Nos. 333-224426 and 333-224426-01). The filing indicates that the company is submitting the Form 6-K in paper as permitted by Regulation S-T Rule 101(b)(1) and (b)(7). The report was signed by Thomas Corbett, Senior Vice President of the company, on January 24, 2019.
